newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends sharply lower on fund liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends sharply lower on fund liquidation.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended sharply lower with July down nearly the 30-cent per cwt limit on massive fund liquidation ahead of first notice day, traders said.
"We had a ton of liquidation in the May," a trader said.
Trade sources said Prudential Securities was an aggressive seller of the May while Refco Inc sold at least 250 lots July.
One floor trader estimated the open interest in the limitless May contract fell to 500 to 700 lots on Tuesday, down from 1,042 on Monday.
"They're just getting out," another floor source said. "There's too many receipts posted (for delivery)."
Wednesday is first notice day for deliveries.
May traded as low as $11.20 per cwt, down 30 cents from Monday's close, while the July contract came within a penny of the 30-cent limit.
Rice ended 28-1/2 to four cents per bushel lower with July down 27 at $11.24.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 1,000 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 406 lots.
